Recommended actions (from action codes)

• C-M2.1 — Price Realization Guardrails
  Owner: pricing_lead
  Trigger: sales.price.realization_pct < 0.92%
  Impact: High, DirectMarginImprovement
  Expected: 1.0–3.0 pp
  Confidence: High
  · IDENTIFY each {entity} where price realization falls below threshold
  · FREEZE discretionary discounts for this {entity}
  · ENFORCE approval workflow for any price exception on this {entity}
  ⚠ Trigger only if Gross Margin % < 25%
  ⚠ Do not trigger if mix effect is primary negative driver

• C-S1.1 — Price Discipline Enforcement
  Owner: pricing_manager
  Trigger: sales.pvm.price_effect.amount < 0
  Impact: High, DirectMarginImprovement
  Expected: 0.5–1.5 pp
  Confidence: High
  · IDENTIFY each {entity} breaching gross margin threshold
  · FREEZE new discretionary discounts for this {entity}
  · REQUIRE approval for any price exception on this {entity}
  ⚠ Do not trigger if Net Sales % vs Plan < -10% (structural demand issue)
  ⚠ Do not trigger for SKUs flagged as strategic

• C-S1.2 — Sales Gap Recovery via Price & Pack Adjustment
  Owner: sales_director
  Trigger: sales.net_sales.delta_pct.plan < -0.05%
  Impact: Medium, RevenueUplift
  Expected: 1.0–3.0 %
  Confidence: Medium
  · IDENTIFY each {entity} breaching plan thresholds
  · SELECT eligible products for this {entity} within GM guardrails
  · APPLY temporary price or pack adjustments to this {entity}
  ⚠ Trigger only if Gross Margin % >= 25%
  ⚠ Do not trigger if price effect is structurally negative for 3+ months (hand over to COM-002)
